app.name: Nextcloud Sync
app.description: Sync selected Nextcloud folders into the Cortex knowledge graph — on demand or on a schedule, fully server-side via WebDAV

config.name: NEXTCLOUD_BASE_URL
config.description: Base URL of your Nextcloud instance, e.g. https://cloud.example.com (no trailing slash)

config.name: NEXTCLOUD_USER
config.description: Nextcloud login name (as shown in Settings -> Personal info) - forms the WebDAV path

config.name: NEXTCLOUD_APP_PASSWORD
config.description: Nextcloud app password, pasted as-is (create it under Settings -> Security -> Devices & sessions). Basic auth is assembled and base64-encoded server-side. Stored encrypted.
